chunks: Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal عليه السلام was asked about clay in which there is straw, with which the mosque or the house in which salat (prayer) is performed is plastered.
So he said: “There is no harm.”

key_terms.الطِّينِ: clay used as a building or plastering material
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدُ: the mosque as a place of worship
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection
key_terms.يُطَيَّنُ: is plastered or coated with clay

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to plaster a mosque or prayer area with clay mixed with straw?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling permitting the use of clay mixed with straw for plastering a mosque or a house used for salat (prayer). It indicates that such building material does not pose a problem for the sanctity or use of a place of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.709 - Abu Al-Hasan al-Awwal, Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as), was asked about using clay mixed with straw to plaster the mosque or the house where prayers are offered.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it."
